title: Interactive PLS Model & Path Diagram Explorer

content.intro: Structural Equation Modeling visualizes relationships through path diagrams composed of latent variables (circles) and manifest indicator items (rectangles). Use this interactive simulator to explore the anatomy of an empirical PLS-SEM model, toggling between outer measurement model evaluation and inner structural model hypotheses.
key: Circles represent latent unobservable constructs (e.g. Transformational Leadership, Organizational Agility, Innovation Performance).
Rectangles represent survey questionnaire items or manifest indicators.
Outer model arrows pointing from construct to indicators represent reflective measurement models.
Inner model path arrows connecting constructs represent direct structural hypotheses tested via bootstrapping.
